Queen’s Park Building Services is a family owned business established in Glasgow in 1989 by John and Jackie Russell. It has steadily expanded, building up a secure client base, with a large core of long standing tradesmen employed.

We pride our self in giving clients a personal service and value for money. This can range from new buildings to loft conversions, property extensions and refurbishments, all to a high quality finish. We can call on all trades and specialist services.
